{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,
    region_code TEXT, signup_date TEXT, tier TEXT)

    quantity INTEGER, unit_price_cents INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, order_ts TEXT,
    status INTEGER, channel TEXT, coupon_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE payments (payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, method TEXT,
    amount_twd INTEGER, paid_ts TEXT, payment_status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT, product_name TEXT,
    category TEXT, list_price_twd INTEGER, is_active INTEGER)

    shipped_ts TEXT, delivered_ts TEXT)"}

{"thought": "依語意層，淨營收以台北時間 2025-11 的有效訂單（status IN (1,2,3)）計算，北部客戶為 region_code 'TW-N'，退款歸屬原訂單。unit_price_cents 的單位需要確認，因此同時查一筆樣本與 products 的 list_price_twd 比對。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["WITH nv AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code = 'TW-N' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025-11') SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM nv)) AS gross_raw, (SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM nv)) AS refund_twd, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nv) AS valid_orders", "SELECT oi.item_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price_cents, p.list_price_twd FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LIMIT 10"]}}

{"thought": "淨營收的退款扣減項需確認是否與訂單明細對得上（有無孤立或超額退款），避免重複扣減。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "WITH nv AS (SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code = 'TW-N' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours')) = '2025-11') SELECT COUNT(*) AS refund_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.item_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched_item, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.item_id IS NOT NULL AND r.order_id <> oi.order_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_mismatch, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.item_id IS NOT NULL AND r.refund_amount_twd > oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents / 100.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_item_refund FROM refunds r LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id = r.item_id WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM nv)"}}

response: {"thought": "依語意層與驗證結果：2025-11（台北時間）、region_code TW-N、status IN (1,2,3) 的有效訂單，商品金額 = quantity × unit_price_cents / 100 為 14,041,575 元，扣除原訂單退款 618,462 元，共 123 筆退款皆可對應到明細且未超額。", "tool": "submit_answer", "args": {"answer": "13423113", "basis": "北部客戶定義為 customers.region_code='TW-N'；期間以 order_ts+8 小時的台北時間歸屬 2025-11，有效訂單為 status IN (1,2,3)。淨營收 = 有效訂單商品金額（quantity×unit_price_cents/100，TWD）14,041,575 元 − 原訂單對應退款 618,462 元 = 13,423,113 元；退款皆能對應到訂單明細且未超過明細金額。"}}
